theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lc_fd_series_limit
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (X Z : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (R : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2)) (S : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (V L : Set (Euclid P)) (Λ : NNReal), m + 1 < P → IsCompact L → IsIntegerMultiplicity Y → (∀ r, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Z r)) → (∀ r, (X r).mass ≤ Λ) → (∀ r, IsIntegerMultiplicity (R r) ∧ (R r).support ⊆ L ∧ X (r + 1) - X r - S r = (R r).boundary ∧ (R r).mass + (S r).mass ≤ (2⁻¹ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ r) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) ⊆ V → (∀ r, Z r ω = X r ω) ∧ Tendsto (fun r => X r ω) atTop (𝓝 (Y ω))) → ∀ q : ℕ, ∃ (R' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2)) (S' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity R' ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity S' ∧ Y - Z q - S' = R'.boundary ∧ R'.massOn V + S'.massOn V ≤ 2 * (2⁻¹ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ q
